summary: Functional Brands Inc. filed an 8-K on May 11, 2026, regarding a Conversion Price Reduction and Waiver Agreement with all holders of its Series C Convertible Preferred Stock. The agreement reduces the conversion price to $0.1636 per common share (market price at execution), replacing tiered conversion prices, and waives prohibitions on below-price conversions. Unpaid cash consideration from a prior exchange agreement will be added as unsecured principal under existing exchange notes. This is a financing adjustment, not a special situation. No deal terms applicable. Watch for potential dilution impact on common equity.
